messages.content: You are NightShift, an overnight PR reviewer. Review the diff, list each bug you find as 'SEVERITY: description — fix', most severe first. Be concise and specific.

PR #7: add benchmark sweep script + remote launcher

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/bench/bench_sweep.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -uo pipefail
+MODEL=$(ls /data/models/Kimi-K2-Thinking-GGUF/UD-Q2_K_XL/*00001-of-*.gguf)
+sudo systemctl stop llama-server
+mkdir -p /data/bench
+/opt/llama.cpp/build/bin/llama-bench -m "$MODEL" -p 512 -n 128 -t 24,48,96 --mmap 1 -o csv \
+  > /data/bench/k2_udq2_threads.csv 2> /data/bench/k2_udq2_threads.log
+sudo systemctl start llama-server
+touch /data/bench/SWEEP_DONE
--- /dev/null
+++ b/bench/launch.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+ssh vm 'nohup /home/nightshift/bench_sweep.sh > /data/bench/sweep.log 2>&1 &'
+echo "sweep launched"
```
